title: Not All Instructions Are Forgotten Equal
summary: LLMs lose adherence to in-context instructions unevenly over long coding conversations: per-instruction effects span more than an order of magnitude, and one instruction type is actively harmed by reinforcement. Fit with a Bayesian hierarchical ordered-logit model across 5 models, 12 instruction types, and 3 real open-source codebases.
note: The open-source benchmark is built on Inspect AI (UK AISI's eval framework): deterministic checkers plus a cross-family LLM judge panel. Code release imminent.
